seo.title: About SolPrompter | A Smarter AI Teleprompter
seo.description: Learn about SolPrompter, a free online AI teleprompter built to make presenting, recording and maintaining natural eye contact easier on every device.
seo.ogDescription: Discover why SolPrompter was created and how we are building a more natural, accessible and complete teleprompter experience.

hero.title: Present Naturally. Stay Focused.
hero.description: SolPrompter is an online AI teleprompter built to help people speak confidently, maintain natural eye contact and create professional videos without complicated software.

why.title: Teleprompters Should Adapt to You
paragraphs: Most teleprompter tools expect presenters to follow a fixed scrolling speed, constantly adjust controls or combine several different applications to write, present and record.
We believe the teleprompter should adapt to the speaker—not the other way around.

SolPrompter was created to make presenting feel more natural. AI Voice Scroll follows your speaking pace, Notch Mode keeps your script close to the camera and remote control lets you manage the presentation without interrupting your recording.
Everything is designed to help you focus less on the software and more on the message you want to deliver.

mission.title: Make Professional Presenting Accessible
mission.description: Our mission is to build a powerful, easy-to-use teleprompter that works for everyone—from first-time creators recording on a phone to professional teams managing studio productions.

items.title: Natural Delivery
items.description: Help presenters speak at their own pace without sounding rushed, robotic or overly rehearsed.

items.title: Better Eye Contact
items.description: Place scripts closer to the camera so presentations feel more direct, confident and human.

items.title: Simple Technology
items.description: Turn advanced teleprompter features into an interface that feels clear and comfortable on every device.

items.title: Accessible Creation
items.description: Make professional presenting and recording tools available without unnecessary barriers, distracting advertising or branded watermarks.

differences.title: More Than a Scrolling Script
differences.description: SolPrompter brings the complete presentation workflow into one connected workspace.

items.title: AI Voice Scroll
items.description: The script follows your speech instead of forcing you to match a fixed scrolling speed.

items.title: Notch Teleprompter Mode
items.description: A compact reading area can be positioned close to the camera to reduce visible eye movement.

items.title: Remote Control
items.description: Control scrolling and navigate your script from another phone, tablet or computer.

items.title: Professional Recording
items.description: Present and record in one workflow with support for Full HD and 4K video on compatible devices.

items.title: Script and Recording Management
items.description: Create, organize and reuse scripts while keeping recordings connected to your content.

items.title: Designed for Every Screen
items.description: Use SolPrompter from a desktop, laptop, tablet or smartphone through a responsive, touch-friendly interface.

items.title: Simple by Default
items.description: Essential actions should be immediately understandable without tutorials, complex settings or a long setup process.

items.title: Powerful When Needed
items.description: Advanced controls should remain available without making the everyday experience feel complicated.

items.title: Natural Over Robotic
items.description: Technology should support the presenter’s speaking rhythm, eye movement and delivery rather than making the presentation feel mechanical.

items.title: Useful on Every Device
items.description: Mobile users should receive a complete and thoughtful experience—not a reduced desktop interface squeezed onto a smaller screen.

items.title: Focused and Distraction-Free

items.title: Respect for Your Content
items.description: Your scripts and recordings belong to you. SolPrompter is designed to help you create without placing a branded watermark over your work.

commitment.title: A Free and Focused Experience
paragraphs: SolPrompter is currently free to use and is being built without distracting advertisements or branded video watermarks.
We want people to experience the complete product, understand how it improves their workflow and help shape what SolPrompter becomes next.
As the platform grows, our priority will remain the same: provide a clear, reliable and valuable experience for presenters and creators.

future.title: Building the Complete Presentation Workspace
paragraphs: Our vision extends beyond basic teleprompter scrolling.
We are building SolPrompter as a complete workspace where users can prepare scripts, present naturally, control sessions remotely, record high-quality video and manage their content from one place.
Future development will continue to focus on intelligent automation, better collaboration, cross-device workflows and tools that reduce the time between writing an idea and recording the final take.
Every feature should solve a real presentation problem—not simply add another setting to the interface.

ecosystem.title: A Focused Tool for Confident Delivery
paragraphs: SolPrompter is built for creators, presenters and digital professionals who want to deliver their message with clarity and confidence.
It brings together the essentials of a practical presentation workflow: preparing a script, presenting naturally, recording high-quality video and managing content in one place.
Every decision is guided by simplicity, thoughtful design and technology that stays out of the way.
